title: Public audiences in Caducus; subscribe and manage pages working end to end
description:
**Goal.** A reader can subscribe, confirm, manage and unsubscribe on the site's own pages, end to end. Today the `/api/notifications/*` routes answer `503 unavailable` and store nothing because Caducus 0.2.0 has no public audiences (docs/notifications.md). Fix the dependency at its cause, in Caducus, and delete the 503 path; no stub store in the plugin, no fallback to the newsletter plugin.

**Design.** Caducus gains a public audience class beside `operator`: a reader directory per site table (address hashed for lookup, encrypted at rest), double opt-in with consent evidence (time, form, wording shown, confirmation), per-kind preferences, manage tokens that never expire, suppression and erasure. It stays generic (no Papyrus words) so every product reuses it. The Papyrus plugin only maps routes to Caducus calls. PPY-f361ee (reader pages) then ships against the real routes.

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Public audiences
  Scenario: Double opt-in
    Given a site with notifications on and a public kind
    When a reader submits their address on the site's notifications page
    Then a confirmation email is sent and nothing else is sent until they confirm
    And after they follow the link the page says they are subscribed, in the site's design

  Scenario: Consent evidence
    When a reader confirms
    Then the record holds the time, the form, the wording they saw and the confirmation time

  Scenario: Preferences
    Given a confirmed subscriber follows the manage link
    When they turn a kind off
    Then they receive no more of that kind and still receive the others

  Scenario: Unsubscribe
    When a reader uses the one-click unsubscribe header or the page
    Then they are unsubscribed within the same request and the address stays suppressed

  Scenario: Erasure
    When an admin erases a reader
    Then the record, the consent evidence and the preferences are gone and the address cannot be re-imported silently

  Scenario: Bad link
    When someone opens a manage link that is no good
    Then they land on the site's expired page, not an /api address

  Scenario: Abuse
    When one address or one network submits far above what readers do
    Then further submissions are refused and no extra email is sent (adaptive limit learned from the site's own signups, not a fixed number)
```

**Depends on:** Caducus release with public audiences (file on the Caducus board and link); PPY-44721a. Blocks PPY-f361ee, the Analytics story and the ownership story.
**Related:** PPY-f361ee, PPY-d7443d, PPY-99738c (no dual-shape paths).

**Open questions for Ryan:** (1) Should a reader be able to subscribe by signing in, or by address only, for launch?
